prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1452; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you were involved in while driving in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you tell me in your own words what happened?

A: I was changing lanes on the highway, moving over to get to the exit. I checked my mirror and didn't see anyone right beside me, so I started to merge. The other vehicle came up on my side and we scraped along each other. Both of our cars got damaged on the passenger side and mine swerved a little before I got it back under control.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began your lane change?

A: Not that I recall. It seemed to come out of my blind spot pretty quickly.

Q: Were you able to stop safely afterward?

A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder. The other driver pulled over too, and we exchanged information.

Q: Did you or anyone in your vehicle get hurt?

A: I did. My lower back tightened up right away, and by that evening I had a lot of stiffness and pain. I went to an urgent care clinic the next day.

Q: Have you received any treatment since then?

A: I've been going to physical therapy about twice a week and I'm taking anti-inflammatory medication. It's still bothering me when I sit for long periods or lift anything heavy.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add or correct about your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm just hoping to get my car repaired and get this back issue taken care of.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
